title: The Big Bang and the Universe
seo_title: Grade 10 Science: The Big Bang and the Universe Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: The formation of the universe can be explained by the big bang theory: evidence (red shift, cosmic background radiation), the formation of galaxies and stars, and astronomical data and distances. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 10, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Grade 10 science worksheets (BC): distances in space, stars, galaxies, red shift, evidence for the big bang, and the origin of the elements. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The universe began about 13.8 billion years ago.
body_html:
How to think about it

The big bang theory says the universe began about 13.8 billion years ago from an extremely hot, dense state and has been expanding ever since. Evidence includes the red shift of light from distant galaxies (they are moving away) and the cosmic microwave background radiation.

Gravity pulled gas together to form stars and galaxies. Stars make heavier elements by fusion; very heavy elements form in supernovas. Distances are measured in light years and astronomical units (AU).

Example

Light from a galaxy is shifted toward red. What does this tell us?

Like a siren going away

Answer: the galaxy is moving away

Example

About how old is the universe?

Billions of years

Answer: 13.8 billion years

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the big bang was an explosion into empty space.
  • Thinking a light year is a unit of time.
  • Thinking all elements were made in the big bang.
